Location: Mascot 2020
Salary: $78,000 – $85,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)
Job Type: Full-time

Just Better Care Eastern Suburbs is looking for passionate Clinical Support Worker to join our caring and dynamic team.

We provide in-home disability and aged care services, supporting people to live independently and with dignity. We believe that people of all ages and abilities deserve access to the support and resources they need to live where and how they choose.

Our office services four key areas in the Sydney Metro region: Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, Sutherland, and St George.

About the Role

This role involves working directly with customers, supporting them in various aspects of daily living while respecting their independence, dignity, and safety. You will be providing assistance to customers with physical, mental, emotional, and social disabilities in their homes and communities.

Main Duties:

- Assisting clients with their personal care needs such as showering, dressing and eating.
- Assisting clients with their mobility and communication needs.
- Participating in planning the care of individuals.
- Following therapy plans such as interventions to assist those with dementia and behavioural problems.
- Observing and reporting changes in client’s condition, and reporting complaints about care.
- Assisting with rehabilitation exercises, basic treatment and delivering medications.
- Providing direct support and assistance to therapists.
- The Clinical Support Worker provides and delivers individual and personalised support and resources to customers, so that they may continue to live in their homes.
- The Clinical Support Worker responsibilities may include, working under the guidance and supervision of medical professionals, monitoring and communicating customer’s condition to the Coordinator, transportation, light domestic duties, personal hygiene, providing meals and other health and wellness related activities.
- The Clinical Support Workers will demonstrate a commitment to best practice, ensuring that all services are provided in a caring and respectful way in accordance with Just Better Care’s policy and procedures.

Essential Requirements:

Essential

- AQF Certificate II or III (ANZSCO Skill Level 4)
- At least one year of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to the formal qualification.
- Experience in high care such as spinal cord injury, palliative care, mental health support, catheter care, or epilepsy/seizure management.
- Previous experience with manual handling and various types of assistive equipment.
- Registration or licensing may be required.
- NDIS Worker Screening Clearance / Criminal Record Check
- Current First Aid certificate/CPR
- Current Australian Drivers Licence
- Reliable, registered, and insured vehicle
- Smartphone with internet access
- Proof of Working Rights in Australia (i.e. Birth Certificate/Citizenship Certificate/Passport/VISA)
- Ability to be reliably contacted via telephone and email
- Experience or willingness to assist with personal care and daily living tasks
- Reliable, punctual, and efficient in completing duties
- Respectful, client-focused attitude with a commitment to quality care
- Team-oriented with good communication and interpersonal skills
- Willingness to learn, develop skills, and participate in ongoing training
- Good written and spoken English skills for effective workplace communication

Desirable

- Current Working with Children Check (where required in accordance with state based legislation)

Why Join Just Better Care

- Be part of a close-knit, friendly, and supportive team
- Career development and ongoing training opportunities
- Strong internal support network – we care about your success
- Competitive salary and benefits
- Access to our Employee Assistance Program

Empowering People In Communities (EPIC) is a not-for-profit organisation that offers disability support and community services in the Pilbara and Goldfields.
Our aim is to empower clients through a range of services that support many people to live a more connected life through community.

Location: 
Port Hedland

Opportunity:
We’re seeking dedicated and compassionate Full Time Support Workers who are looking to challenge themselves and build on their skills and knowledge. We are seeking candidates who have a strong focus on personal care with flexible availability to cover a variety of shifts including but not limited to overnight shifts. This role provides a variety of support services including personal care, domestic and lifestyle support, and community inclusion, all guided by the participant’s individual NDIS support plan.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Provide high-quality support that enhances independence, encourages participation, and aligns with individual goals.
- Deliver culturally appropriate support that respects the diversity of participants.
- Take direction from the person being supported, their family, and EPIC’s Client Coordinator.
- Maintain professionalism and positive relationships with clients, families, and colleagues.

- Working with Children Check (mandatory)
- Availability for night shifts and sleepovers
- Demonstrated respect for people with disability and commitment to inclusion
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and communicate effectively
- Experience using digital rostering systems
- Willingness to work across a variety of shifts, including weekends and after-hours

Desirable  
- Previous experience providing personal care
- Experience supporting people with disability (formally or informally)
- Experience working with children
- Complex care experience (e.g. PEG feeding, fluids, puree diets)
- Manual handling experience or qualification
- Knowledge of NDIS Quality and Safeguards
- Certificate IV in Disability or Community Services

Why join the EPIC Team?
- Above Award Rates
- Salary Sacrifice up to $15,900 per annum
- Additional leave after 12 months service (part-time only)
- Quarterly bonus scheme
- Employee Assistance Program
- Training opportunities
- Corporate Health Insurance Discounts
- Access to discounts at over 9,000 retail locations across Australia

Shortlisting and interviews may commence as applications are received. EPIC reserves the right to close the advertisement early if a suitable candidate is identified.

To access the full Position Description or for further questions, please contact hr@empoweringpeople.org.au

EPIC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Due to the nature of participant preferences and support needs, female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply for this role. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people are encouraged to apply.

We are seeking a quick commencement, working alongside other support workers with our clients, this team support role is based in Kippa Ring, Moreton Bay. Our centre based clients are typically children and teenagers with a range of disabilities. However we support a range of adults across Moreton Bay as well. This role has the potential to do both.

You will need to bring your high level behavioural support skills, your critical thinking, risk management and negotiation skills along with your warm, engaged and fun-loving personality.

This role is not for the faint hearted. We work with multiple neurodiverse clients, many of whom are non-verbal and considered high risk. To do this we provide a unique model of support in a purpose built centre, with community access plans and home based supports as well. You need to be able to follow a group plan, contribute effectively to strategy reviews and hold your own when managing complex behaviours, while maintaining a neuro-affirming approach to support.

You will require:

Qld WWC and NDIS Worker Screening check
Current police check
Drivers Licence, Car and comprehensive insurance
Minimum Certificate III level qualification in Individual Support, Disability, Education Support, Allied Health (OT, Speech, Physio), Early Childhood Education or a relevant field. Higher level tertiary qualifications will be highly valued and open different opportunities for promotion and development.
Current First Aid and CPR Qualifications

You will be happy and confident in your ability to get down to play and engage with children on the floor, and to support them while they climb and swim. You must be capable of promoting a healthy lifestyle to children, teenagers and adults in our care.

Hours vary, but you must be available after school and on Saturday’s during school terms, and on school holiday’s the more available you are the more hours you can have. We are seeking a quick commencement, working alongside other support workers with our clients, this team support role is based in Kippa Ring, Moreton Bay. Our centre based clients are typically children and teenagers with a range of disabilities. However we support a range of adults across Moreton Bay as well. This role has the potential to do both.

You will need to bring your high level behavioural support skills, your critical thinking, risk management and negotiation skills along with your warm, engaged and fun-loving personality.

This role is not for the faint hearted. We work with multiple neurodiverse clients, many of whom are non-verbal and considered high risk. To do this we provide a unique model of support in a purpose built centre, with community access plans and home based supports as well. You need to be able to follow a group plan, contribute effectively to strategy reviews and hold your own when managing complex behaviours, while maintaining a neuro-affirming approach to support.

Qld WWC and NDIS Worker Screening check
Current police check
Drivers Licence, Car and comprehensive insurance
Minimum Certificate III level qualification in Individual Support, Disability, Education Support, Allied Health (OT, Speech, Physio), Early Childhood Education or a relevant field. Higher level tertiary qualifications will be highly valued and open different opportunities for promotion and development.
Current First Aid and CPR Qualifications


To physically handle the demands of this role you will need to be fit, healthy and have no lingering injuries that prevent you from a fast unexpected run at pace. You will have quick reactions. You will be happy and confident in your ability to get down to play and engage with children on the floor, and to support them while they climb and swim. You must be capable of promoting a healthy lifestyle to children, teenagers and adults in our care.

Hours vary, but you must be available after school and on Saturday’s during school terms, and on school holiday’s the more available you are the more hours you can have. This role is currently well suited to educators from special schools, teachers, allied health professionals, however we welcome anyone meeting the minimum requirements, skills, personal traits and availabilities to apply.

On offer is a fun-loving, considered risk-taking team who will help you get the best from your clients. We offer internal and external training opportunities, the use of company vehicles as needed, stable and reliable shifts for those who can do the work successfully. With regular team meetings and consultative management, an active EAP in place, we offer a supportive and dynamic work environment.

There is solid potential to grow your hours for the right fit for the clients and team. Pay is negotiable with qualifications and experience. This is an employment position, ABN holders need not apply.
